task: Our planet's government wants to open a branch of our super successful mountain-ski resorts system on the <ToPlanet> planet in the <ToStar> system. We scheduled the official opening of the resort on <Date> but unfortunately, the local manager leaves much to be desired. You are a famous trader, <Ranger>, so we request you to hold a master class on resort management for him. If you manage to increase the initial capital up to a certain amount within 20 days, you'll get the award in the amount of <Money> credits. They will explain all the details to you right on the spot.
success: We are contented with the results of your work. Our new manager is enthused over you and your management style! You, <Ranger>, fully deserved this award in the amount of <Money> credits!

loc.54.0:
The acting general manager of the mountain-ski resort, a Gaalian, met you in the spaceport; from now on while you take the position of the general manager, he will be your <clr> deputy <clrEnd>. On your way to the mountains, he explained that up to the minute <clr>one ski lift, one track for beginners, one hotel and one restaurant <clrEnd> were constructed. The remaining on the account capital is <clr>100.000<clrEnd> cr, and your goal is to increase it up to <clr>1.000.000<clrEnd> cr.

The place where you arrived turned out to be rather picturesque. There was a small hotel and a bistro almost adjoining the hillsides. You looked more attentively and also noticed a small ski lift with chairs and a soft track. There was a tiny administration and personnel building near the hotel. This is where your office is - right near the bedroom.

- Well, the time convenient for construction is already over for today but you could talk to the experts or just have a rest, - the Gaalian said.

1) <clr>Hotel<clrEnd> - costs <clr>110.000<clrEnd> cr, accommodates <clr>60<clrEnd> people. 
2) <clr>Restaurant<clrEnd> - costs <clr>80.000<clrEnd> cr, feeds <clr>45<clrEnd> people. 
3) <clr>Track for beginners<clrEnd> - costs <clr>30.000<clrEnd> cr, receives <clr>20<clrEnd> beginners. 
4) <clr>Track for pros<clrEnd> - costs <clr>60.000<clrEnd> cr, receives <clr>20<clrEnd> pros. 
5) <clr>Average track<clrEnd> - costs <clr>45.000<clrEnd> cr, receives <clr>10<clrEnd> beginners and <clr>10<clrEnd> pros. 
6) <clr>A ski lift with chairs<clrEnd> - costs <clr>80.000<clrEnd> cr, holds <clr>30<clrEnd> people. 
7)<clr> A ski lift with cabins<clrEnd> - costs <clr>110.000<clrEnd> cr, holds <clr>50<clrEnd> people.

Every track receives up to <clr>20<clrEnd> clients. Tracks for beginners and pros receive <clr>20<clrEnd> beginners and pros each, and <clr>10<clrEnd> skiers from each category can use an average track. 

Now about the money. <clr>Track maintenance expenses <clrEnd> include <clr>10.000<clrEnd> cr for each soft track, <clr>15.000<clrEnd> cr for an average track and <clr>20.000<clrEnd> cr for a difficult track per day. Every <clr>beginner<clrEnd> pays us <clr>2.000<clrEnd> cr per day, and every <clr> professional <clrEnd> - <clr>6.000<clrEnd> cr. <clr>Advertising <clrEnd> expenses you define yourself.

loc.57.0:
Being a civilised individual, you spent the rest of the evening in the local bar, thanks to free of charge services. It was very late already when you pottered to your bed and fell asleep like a dog. 

When you woke up in the morning feeling slightly crapulent, you fixed yourself up and went to the office to get acquainted with the current situation.
loc.57.1:
So, why don't you command the services of your own resort? After choosing the softest track, you put on the skies and rose to the top of the hill. However, mountain skiing is not equal to driving a spaceship! You fell of the track after the first turn and slid the rest of the way down the hill on your back. This incident discouraged you from any extreme entertainment till the evening.

Next morning you went to the office with all your body aching. What makes tourists come to your resort and pay tons of money for that, you wonder?
loc.57.2:
You went to your bedroom and spent the rest of the evening watching stereoTV. There - they raised the Maloq stool market in the Pepper sector! Heh, what a bargain it could have been if you hadn't been marooned on this damn piece of planet!

You went to bed completely upset. However, in the morning you sat at your desk in the office trying to console yourself with the thought that <Money> cr promised by the <FromPlanet> government are good money too.
loc.57.3: The rest of the day you watched the tourists sliding downhill on their skies. Whatever might happen, your business is great and rewarding! Reassured by such a simple thought, you went to bed and in the morning ran to the office with a strong desire to make your resort the best place in the Galaxy!
loc.57.4:
Today you decided to play cards with your deputy and within several hours lost <clr>1.000<clrEnd> cr. Well, they are right warning that one should better avoid playing cards with Gaalians or Pelengs! Anyway, you had nothing else to do but to sign papers for his bonus in the amount of the lost money. It would be absolutely unwise to pay him from your own pocket!

No wonder that your mood was far from being good when you came to the office in the morning.
loc.57.5:
You asked your deputy to give you a ride around the neighbourhood on his aerocar. One should mention that your resort looks even more beautiful from the bird's-eye view. Is it possible at all to dislike such a nice place?!

Due to these good impressions, in the morning you got to work with increased enthusiasm!
loc.57.6:
The rest of the day you were yawning your life away. What fun do these dull tourists find in such a poky hole of a place as your resort?! Indeed, a true space ace will never understand these planet inhabitants...

You hit the hay at last and slept till the midday. And that was right - a space ranger doesn't have to wake up in the small hours for absolutely useless tourists! The report as of the previous day had already been waiting for you in the office for a long time.
loc.57.7:
You spent the whole day searching in the planet web net. There, they soak professionals at the neighbouring resort charging 7 thousands per day! Though their popularity is much lower than yours. It's a pity you don't have the right to change the hard and fast tour prices specified by the <FromPlanet> planet...

You grabbed your breakfast in the morning and went to the office to solve your resort's problems.
loc.57.8:
Today you found yourself falling into talk with your construction manager. And it turned out that he used to be a ranger in his youth too! But once he got a mission to construct a Maloq outpost on an uninhibited planet. He liked this kind of work so much that decided to change his profession and become a constructor.

You spent all evening exchanging your reminiscences about the life of a ranger and parted completely satisfied with each other and the time spent together. In the morning you acted with renewed energy.
loc.57.9: No sooner had you come down to the bar for the deserved rest than some nimble Peleng who turned out to be a local journalist waylaid you. You had to spend all evening being interviewed and buying him beer on the house. But then the Peleng seemed to be pleased and wrote a nice article because when you came to the office in the morning, you found out that <clr>the resort's popularity increased a little bit <clrEnd>.
